newsitem.title: USA: Marvel sees Q4 shr loss $4-$4.35. [CORRECTED 16:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Marvel sees Q4 shr loss $4-$4.35. [CORRECTED 16:10 GMT]

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Corp said Monday it expects to report a fourth-quarter loss of $405-$440 million, or $4-$4.35 per share.
The company also said it expects to report a loss of $435-$470 million, or $4.25-$4.60 per share, for the full year.

The company said the potential lower-than-expected figures stem from lower results from operations. It said results were hurt by its inability to recognize (corrects word from "reorganize") potential tax benefits, as well as reorganization expenses related to its Chapter 11 filing in December.
Marvel said the losses would cause it to have a negative shareholder equity of $225-$260 million.
The company said it reported a loss of $58.5 million, or $0.58 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1995, and a loss of $48.4 million, or $0.48 per share, for the full year.

Marvel said the 1996 fourth-quarter and full-year results will include special charges of $350-$385 million, primarily related to its trading card operations but also from a reduction of goodwill, a write-off of tax-related assets, and reorganization expenses.
